page.notes: Two columns of index entries, all lines transcribed as <l>. The Greek words in the entry "ευσφγεια & πεάξεις" and in "Epistolis Graecis cur praefigatur" are not legible letter by letter at this scan resolution; the Greek is marked with [?] or as illegible rather than guessed. The entry "erratęs" keeps the printed ę. The u/v spelling was normalised (uirtutem to virtutem, uoluptatem to voluptatem, uersatur to versatur, uerbi to verbi). Long s is plain s throughout; "fuis" in print is read as "suis". The page number X is the Roman numeral at top right, and the running head is INDEX.
